# Kinu – LLM Quick Reference

> Kinu is a performance-focused Preact UI component library (~1.2 KB JS, ~6 KB CSS).
> It enhances native HTML elements with a `k` attribute for CSS styling and minimal JS behavior.
> Peer dependency: preact@^10.26.8

## Setup

```bash
pnpm add kinu   # or: npm install kinu
```

```ts
import 'kinu/style.css';           // Load once at app root
import { Button, Card } from 'kinu'; // Tree-shake individual components
```

## How It Works

- Components render native HTML with a `k="component-name"` attribute for CSS targeting.
- Props map directly to HTML attributes — no runtime prop filtering.
- Overlays use the native `<dialog>` element with a command/commandFor polyfill.
- All types are exported: `import type { ButtonProps } from 'kinu';`

## Shared Props (BaseProps)

Every component extends BaseProps:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| command | `"show-modal" \| "close" \| "show-popover" \| "hide-popover" \| "toggle-popover" \| \`--\${string}\`` | Command to invoke on target |
| commandFor | `string` | ID of target element for the command |
| children | `ComponentChildren` | Component contents |

## Component Index

| Component | Category | Renders As | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Button | Actions | (composite) | Button component that forwards props to `<button>` or `<a>` when href is provided. |
| Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogClose | Actions | (composite) | Composable modal built on the native `<dialog>` element. |
| AlertDialog | Actions | (composite) | Alias of Dialog with alert-focused styling defaults. |
| Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerClose | Actions | (composite) | Bottom sheet style overlay with trigger and close helpers. |
| DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem | Actions | (composite) | Command-driven dropdown built on top of `<dialog>`. |
| ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem | Actions | (composite) | Right-click context menu powered by the native dialog element. |
| Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetClose | Actions | (composite) | Side or bottom sheet overlay with directional variants. |
| Badge | Data Display | <span> | Tiny inline status indicator with multiple tone variants. |
| Accordion | Data Display | <details> | Disclosure built on the native `<details>` element with smooth open and close animation. |
| Avatar | Data Display | (composite) | Styled `<img>` avatar that falls back to initials from the alt text. |
| Card | Data Display | <div> | Surface container with padding, border, and typography defaults. |
| Collapsible | Data Display | <details> | Minimal hide/show container built on `<details>` without default markers. |
| Table | Data Display | <table> | Table wrapper with zebra striping and compact density. |
| Tree | Data Display | (composite) | Composable tree view built from native `<details>` and `<summary>` primitives. |
| Skeleton | Data Display | <div> | Animated shimmer placeholder for loading states. |
| Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext | Data Display | (composite) | Scroll snapping carousel with previous/next helpers. |
| HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent | Data Display | <div> | Delayed hover preview card with trigger/content primitives. |
| Input | Data Input | <input> | Text input with size, tone, and invalid states handled in CSS. |
| Checkbox | Data Input | <input> | Accessible checkbox input with custom visuals. |
| InputGroup | Data Input | <fieldset> | Compact fieldset wrapper for joined controls like input and button rows. |
| RadioGroup, Radio | Data Input | <div> | Container that styles a set of native radio inputs. |
| Select | Data Input | <select> | Styled native `<select>` element with size variants. |
| Slider | Data Input | <input> | Range input with CSS-driven track and thumb styling. |
| Calendar | Data Input | <input> | Styled wrapper around the native `<input type="date">` element. |
| Switch | Data Input | <input> | Accessible toggle switch built from a checkbox input. |
| ComboboxInput, ComboboxList, ComboboxOption, Combobox | Data Input | <input> | Autocomplete input with trigger, list, and option primitives. |
| ColorPicker | Data Input | <input> | Styled color swatch input that opens the native OS color picker. |
| FileUpload | Data Input | <input> | Native file input with a styled button for selecting local files. |
| DatePicker | Data Input | <input> | Styled date input that shares the same foundation as Calendar. |
| TimePicker | Data Input | <input> | Styled time input that shares the same foundation as Date Picker. |
| Label | Data Input | <label> | Typography-aligned label component for form controls. |
| Textarea | Data Input | <textarea> | Text area with matching input styling, variants, and sizes. |
| Toggle | Data Input | <button> | ARIA-pressed aware button for on/off interactions. |
| ToggleGroup | Data Input | <div> | Container that lets Toggle buttons coordinate pressed state. |
| Alert | Feedback | <div> | Inline status message with tone variants. |
| Tooltip | Feedback | <span> | Hover/focus tooltip with placement attributes and CSS timing. |
| Spinner | Feedback | <span> | Inline loading indicator for compact pending states. |
| Progress | Feedback | <progress> | Styled progress meter with determinate and indeterminate states. |
| AspectRatio | Layout | (composite) | Maintains responsive boxes at a fixed ratio using pure CSS. |
| Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverClose | Layout | (composite) | Lightweight popover using native dialog with trigger/content primitives. |
| ScrollArea | Layout | <div> | Overflow wrapper with custom scrollbars and shadow indicators. |
| Resizable | Layout | <div> | Resizable container that exposes native CSS handles. |
| Separator | Layout | <div> | Semantic horizontal or vertical divider. |
| SidebarTrigger, Sidebar | Layout | <button> | Responsive sidebar dialog that collapses on mobile. |
| TabList, Tab, TabPanel | Navigation | <div> | TabList, Tab, and TabPanel wrappers using aria attributes. |
| Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink | Navigation | <nav> | Composable breadcrumb trail built from list primitives. |
| NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink | Navigation | <nav> | Composable navigation with list, item, and link helpers. |
| Menubar, MenubarItem | Navigation | <nav> | Horizontal command bar composed of styled buttons. |
| Pagination, PaginationList, PaginationItem, PaginationLink | Navigation | <nav> | Semantic pagination list with previous/next helpers. |

## Component Usage

### Button

Button component that forwards props to `<button>` or `<a>` when href is provided.

- **Button**

```tsx
import {Button} from 'kinu';

<Button variant="outline">Action</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `ButtonVariant` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |
| size | `ButtonSize` | 'md' | Size preset for the button. |
| loading | `boolean` | — | Shows a pending state and disables interactions. |
| href | `string` | — | When provided, renders the Button as an anchor element. |
| target | `string | undefined | null` | — | Target for anchor elements. |
| rel | `string | undefined | null` | — | Relationship between the current page and the linked resource. |
| onClick | `(event: MouseEvent) => void | null` | — | Click handler for the button. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disables interactions and applies disabled styling. |
| type | `string | undefined | null` | — | Button type attribute. |

- Use the loading attribute to reflect pending state without extra handlers.
- Supports size attributes (sm, md, lg, icon) controlled purely with CSS.

### Dialog

Composable modal built on the native `<dialog>` element.

- **Dialog**
- **DialogTrigger**
- **DialogContent**
- **DialogClose**

- `Dialog.Trigger` = `DialogTrigger`
- `Dialog.Content` = `DialogContent`
- `Dialog.Close` = `DialogClose`

```tsx
import {Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>Modal body</DialogContent>
  <DialogClose><Button>Close</Button></DialogClose>
</Dialog>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dialog.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |
| DialogContent.id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

- Relies on command attributes instead of portal gymnastics.
- Dialog.Content forwards all native `<dialog>` props.

### Alert Dialog

Alias of Dialog with alert-focused styling defaults.

- **AlertDialog**

```tsx
import {AlertDialog} from 'kinu';

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger>Delete</AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Content>Confirm action</AlertDialog.Content>
</AlertDialog>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

- Re-exports Dialog so you get Trigger, Content, Close, and other helpers.
- Use when you want dialog markup that communicates a destructive decision.

### Drawer

Bottom sheet style overlay with trigger and close helpers.

- **Drawer**
- **DrawerTrigger**
- **DrawerContent**
- **DrawerClose**

- `Drawer.Trigger` = `DrawerTrigger`
- `Drawer.Content` = `DrawerContent`
- `Drawer.Close` = `DrawerClose`

```tsx
import {Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>Content</DrawerContent>
  <DrawerClose><Button>Close</Button></DrawerClose>
</Drawer>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drawer.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the drawer dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |
| DrawerContent.id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

- Positions content with CSS variables so you can change direction.
- Attach Drawer.Close to any element that should dismiss.

### Dropdown Menu

Command-driven dropdown built on top of `<dialog>`.

- **DropdownMenu**
- **DropdownMenuTrigger**
- **DropdownMenuContent**
- **DropdownMenuItem**

```tsx
import {DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger} from 'kinu';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Item</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DropdownMenu.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dropdown content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |
| DropdownMenuContent.id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |
| DropdownMenuContent.command | `string` | 'close' | Command dispatched when the dialog receives the command event. |
| DropdownMenuContent.commandFor | `string` | — | Target dialog identifier for the command dispatch. |
| DropdownMenuContent.to | `"left"` | — | Align the menu panel to the trigger's left or right edge. |
| DropdownMenuItem.href | `string` | — | When provided, renders the item as an anchor element. |
| DropdownMenuItem.selected | `boolean` | — | Marks the item as selected for styling. |
| DropdownMenuItem.shortcut | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| DropdownMenuItem.destructive | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the item. |

- Menu items render as `<button>` elements by default.
- Automatically closes when an item dispatches the close command.

### Context Menu

Right-click context menu powered by the native dialog element.

- **ContextMenuTrigger**
- **ContextMenu**
- **ContextMenuContent**
- **ContextMenuItem** → <button>

```tsx
import {ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuTrigger} from 'kinu';

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger>Right click this area</ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuItem>Copy</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ContextMenu.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the context menu dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |
| ContextMenuContent.id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |
| ContextMenuItem.selected | `boolean` | — | Marks the item as selected for styling. |
| ContextMenuItem.shortcut | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| ContextMenuItem.destructive | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the item. |

- Installs the commands polyfill when rendered.
- Menu content is focus-trapped via `<dialog>`.

### Sheet

Side or bottom sheet overlay with directional variants.

- **Sheet**
- **SheetTrigger**
- **SheetContent**
- **SheetClose**

- `Sheet.Trigger` = `SheetTrigger`
- `Sheet.Content` = `SheetContent`
- `Sheet.Close` = `SheetClose`

```tsx
import {Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger><Button>Open</Button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">Panel</SheetContent>
  <SheetClose><Button>Close</Button></SheetClose>
</Sheet>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sheet.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the sheet dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |
| SheetContent.id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

- Control the slide direction with the side attribute on SheetContent.
- SheetClose attaches the close command to any child element.

### Badge

Tiny inline status indicator with multiple tone variants.

- **Badge** → <span>

```tsx
import {Badge} from 'kinu';

<Badge variant="secondary">New</Badge>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `BadgeVariant` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |

### Accordion

Disclosure built on the native `<details>` element with smooth open and close animation.

- **Accordion** → <details>

```tsx
import {Accordion} from 'kinu';

<Accordion open>
  <summary>Details</summary>
  <p>Hidden content</p>
</Accordion>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | `boolean` | — | Controls the open state of the details element. |

- Forwards every native `<details>` attribute so you can control open state.
- Provide your own `<summary>` element to define the trigger.

### Avatar

Styled `<img>` avatar that falls back to initials from the alt text.

- **Avatar**

```tsx
import {Avatar} from 'kinu';

<Avatar alt="JM" src="/user.jpg" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| src | `string` | — | Image source for the avatar. |
| alt | `string` | — | Alt text used by the image and for fallback initials. |
| children | `element.children` | — | Fallback initials or text rendered via the alt attribute. |
| size | `AvatarSize` | — | Size preset for the avatar. |

- Uses the alt attribute content as a CSS-rendered fallback when the image fails.
- Override dimensions in CSS if you need sizes other than the 2rem default.

### Card

Surface container with padding, border, and typography defaults.

- **Card** → <div>

```tsx
import {Card} from 'kinu';

<Card>
  <h3>Title</h3>
  <p>Content</p>
</Card>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| padding | `CardPadding` | 'md' | Padding preset for the card content. |

- Wraps a `<div>` and exposes padding/variant control via attributes.

### Collapsible

Minimal hide/show container built on `<details>` without default markers.

- **Collapsible** → <details>

```tsx
import {Collapsible} from 'kinu';

<Collapsible open summary="Trigger">Hidden content</Collapsible>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | `boolean` | — | Controls the open state of the details element. |

- Expose the open attribute for controlled usage.
- Great for FAQs when you want custom trigger markup.

### Table

Table wrapper with zebra striping and compact density.

- **Table** → <table>

```tsx
import {Table} from 'kinu';

<Table>
  <thead>...</thead>
  <tbody>...</tbody>
</Table>
```

- Uses native `<table>` markup so semantics stay intact.
- Supports sticky headers via CSS attribute toggles.

### Tree

Composable tree view built from native `<details>` and `<summary>` primitives.

- **Tree**

```tsx
import {Tree} from 'kinu';

<Tree>
  <Tree.Group open>
    <Tree.GroupLabel>src</Tree.GroupLabel>
    <Tree.GroupItems>
      <Tree.Item>index.ts</Tree.Item>
    </Tree.GroupItems>
  </Tree.Group>
</Tree>
```

- State is native via the `open` attribute on `Tree.Group`.
- Nest `Tree.Group` inside `Tree.GroupItems` for deeper hierarchies.

### Skeleton

Animated shimmer placeholder for loading states.

- **Skeleton** → <div>

```tsx
import {Skeleton} from 'kinu';

<Skeleton style={{height: "1.5rem"}} />
```

- Wraps a `<div>` so you can size it however you want.
- Use data-rounded to switch to pill skeletons.

### Carousel

Scroll snapping carousel with previous/next helpers.

- **Carousel**
- **CarouselContent**
- **CarouselItem** → <div>
- **CarouselPrevious**
- **CarouselNext**

```tsx
import {Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious} from 'kinu';

<Carousel>
  <CarouselContent>
    <CarouselItem>Slide</CarouselItem>
  </CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious />
  <CarouselNext />
</Carousel>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Carousel.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the carousel content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

- Leverages CSS scroll snap for buttery momentum.
- Content remains fully declarative.

### Hover Card

Delayed hover preview card with trigger/content primitives.

- **HoverCard** → <div>
- **HoverCardTrigger** → <span>
- **HoverCardContent** → <div>

```tsx
import {HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger} from 'kinu';

<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger>Hover me</HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>Details</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
```

- Uses CSS-only timers for opening and closing.
- Content positioning is handled via data attributes.

### Input

Text input with size, tone, and invalid states handled in CSS.

- **Input** → <input>

```tsx
import {Input} from 'kinu';

<Input placeholder="Email" type="email" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size | `InputSize` | 'md' | Size preset for the input field. |
| invalid | `boolean` | — | Marks the input as invalid for styling purposes. |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value. |
| type | `string | undefined` | — | Input type attribute. |
| placeholder | `string` | — | Placeholder text for the input. |
| onInput | `(event: InputEvent) => void` | — | Change handler for controlled inputs. |
| onBlur | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | — | Blur handler. |
| onFocus | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | — | Focus handler. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disables interactions and applies disabled styling. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name attribute used for form submissions. |

- Wraps the native `<input>` element so forms behave as expected.
- Supports size="sm" and size="lg" for compact or spacious layouts.

### Checkbox

Accessible checkbox input with custom visuals.

- **Checkbox** → <input>

```tsx
import {Checkbox} from 'kinu';

<Checkbox checked aria-label="Accept" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| checked | `boolean` | — | Controls the checked state. |
| data-state | `"indeterminate"` | — | Marks the checkbox as indeterminate for styling. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for the checkbox. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the checkbox. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value used for form submissions. |

- Wraps `<input type="checkbox">` so forms just work.
- Supports data-state="indeterminate" styling for tri-state usage.

### Input Group

Compact fieldset wrapper for joined controls like input and button rows.

- **InputGroup** → <fieldset>

```tsx
import {InputGroup} from 'kinu';

<InputGroup>
  <Input placeholder="Search" />
  <Button variant="outline">Go</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

- Uses CSS-only border and radius joining for grouped controls.
- Works with both kinu primitives and native form elements.

### Radio Group

Container that styles a set of native radio inputs.

- **RadioGroup** → <div>
- **Radio** → <input>

```tsx
import {Radio, RadioGroup} from 'kinu';

<RadioGroup>
  <Radio name="plan" value="basic" />
  <Radio name="plan" value="pro" />
</RadioGroup>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Radio.checked | `boolean` | — | Controls the checked state. |
| Radio.name | `string` | — | Radio group name. |
| Radio.value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Radio value used for form submissions. |
| Radio.onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for the radio. |
| Radio.disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the radio input. |

- Radio renders an `<input type="radio">` so browser form behavior stays intact.
- Use the native name/value model or controlled props to manage selection.

### Select

Styled native `<select>` element with size variants.

- **Select** → <select>

```tsx
import {Select} from 'kinu';

<Select>
  <option>One</option>
</Select>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current selected value. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for controlled selects. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the select input. |
| multiple | `boolean` | — | Native multiple selection toggle. |
| size | `number` | — | Number of visible options when using native size. |

- Leverages the platform picker on touch devices.
- Supports native multiple and size attributes.

### Slider

Range input with CSS-driven track and thumb styling.

- **Slider** → <input>

```tsx
import {Slider} from 'kinu';

<Slider min={0} max={100} value={50} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| min | `number` | — | Minimum slider value. |
| max | `number` | — | Maximum slider value. |
| value | `number` | — | Current slider value. |
| step | `number` | — | Step granularity for the slider. |
| onInput | `(event: InputEvent) => void` | — | Change handler for the slider input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the slider. |

- Wraps `<input type="range">` for seamless form integration.
- Supports data-orientation for vertical sliders.

### Calendar

Styled wrapper around the native `<input type="date">` element.

- **Calendar** → <input>

```tsx
import {Calendar} from 'kinu';

<Calendar />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current date value. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for date input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |

- Forwards every standard input attribute, defaulting type to "date".
- Uses the browser's native date picker UI for accessibility and localisation.

### Switch

Accessible toggle switch built from a checkbox input.

- **Switch** → <input>

```tsx
import {Switch} from 'kinu';

<Switch checked />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| checked | `boolean` | — | Controls the checked state. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for the switch. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the switch. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value used for form submissions. |

- It is just a checkbox under the hood so forms stay in sync.
- Use aria-label or pair with `<Label>` for accessible naming.

### Combobox

Autocomplete input with trigger, list, and option primitives.

- **ComboboxInput** → <input>
- **ComboboxList** → <dialog>
- **ComboboxOption** → <button>
- **Combobox**

```tsx
import {Combobox, ComboboxInput, ComboboxList, ComboboxOption} from 'kinu';

<Combobox>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search" />
  <ComboboxList>
    <ComboboxOption>One</ComboboxOption>
  </ComboboxList>
</Combobox>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ComboboxInput.value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value for controlled usage. |
| ComboboxInput.placeholder | `string` | — | Placeholder text for the input. |
| ComboboxInput.onInput | `(event: InputEvent) => void` | — | Change handler for controlled inputs. |
| ComboboxInput.disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| ComboboxOption.selected | `boolean` | — | Marks the option as selected for styling. |
| ComboboxOption.shortcut | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| ComboboxOption.destructive | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the option. |

- Uses command/commandFor attributes for disclosure logic.
- Keep option counts manageable for usability.

### Color Picker

Styled color swatch input that opens the native OS color picker.

- **ColorPicker** → <input>

```tsx
import {ColorPicker} from 'kinu';

<ColorPicker />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current color value as a hex string (e.g. "#ff0000"). |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for the color input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |

- Sets type="color" for you and forwards all native input props.
- Pairs naturally with `Input` inside an `InputGroup` to show an editable hex value alongside the swatch.

### File Upload

Native file input with a styled button for selecting local files.

- **FileUpload** → <input>

```tsx
import {FileUpload} from 'kinu';

<FileUpload accept="image/*" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler called when the user selects files. |
| accept | `string` | — | Allowed file types as MIME types or extensions (e.g. "image/*" or ".pdf"). |
| multiple | `boolean` | — | Allow selecting multiple files. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |

- Sets type="file" for you and forwards all native input props.
- Use the accept prop to restrict selectable file types.
- Use capture="user" or capture="environment" to invoke the camera on mobile.

### Date Picker

Styled date input that shares the same foundation as Calendar.

- **DatePicker** → <input>

```tsx
import {DatePicker} from 'kinu';

<DatePicker />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current date value. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for date input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |

- Sets type="date" for you and forwards all native input props.
- Pairs nicely with popovers if you need a custom calendar shell.

### Time Picker

Styled time input that shares the same foundation as Date Picker.

- **TimePicker** → <input>

```tsx
import {TimePicker} from 'kinu';

<TimePicker />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current time value in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for time input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |
| step | `number` | 60 | Granularity of the time value in seconds.
Common values: 60 (1 min), 900 (15 min), 1800 (30 min). |

- Sets type="time" for you and forwards all native input props.
- Use the step prop to constrain selectable intervals, e.g. step={1800} for 30-minute increments.

### Label

Typography-aligned label component for form controls.

- **Label** → <label>

```tsx
import {Label} from 'kinu';

<Label htmlFor="name">Name</Label>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| htmlFor | `string` | — | ID of the form element this label describes. |

- Wraps the native `<label>` element and forwards htmlFor.
- Pair with controls to provide accessible names.

### Textarea

Text area with matching input styling, variants, and sizes.

- **Textarea** → <textarea>

```tsx
import {Textarea} from 'kinu';

<Textarea rows={4} placeholder="Write here" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rows | `number` | — | Number of visible text rows. |
| placeholder | `string` | — | Placeholder text for the textarea. |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Textarea value. |
| onInput | `(event: InputEvent) => void` | — | Change handler for controlled textareas. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disables interactions and applies disabled styling. |

- Wraps the native `<textarea>` for full form support.
- Use the resize attribute to control user resizing.

### Toggle

ARIA-pressed aware button for on/off interactions.

- **Toggle** → <button>

```tsx
import {Toggle} from 'kinu';

<Toggle pressed={value}>Bold</Toggle>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pressed | `boolean` | — | Controls the pressed state and maps to `aria-pressed` on the DOM element. |
| onClick | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` | — | Click handler for toggling state. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the toggle. |

- Wraps `<button>` so keyboard support comes for free.
- Use the `pressed` prop for state; it maps to `aria-pressed` on the DOM.

### Toggle Group

Container that lets Toggle buttons coordinate pressed state.

- **ToggleGroup** → <div>

```tsx
import {ToggleGroup} from 'kinu';

<ToggleGroup>
  <Toggle>Bold</Toggle>
  <Toggle>Italic</Toggle>
</ToggleGroup>
```

- Each Toggle toggles aria-pressed and clears other toggles in the same group.
- Pass props like disabled or value straight to the underlying `<button>`.

### Alert

Inline status message with tone variants.

- **Alert** → <div>

```tsx
import {Alert} from 'kinu';

<Alert variant="default">Heads up!</Alert>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `"destructive"` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |

- Renders a `<div>` so you can include any markup you need.

### Tooltip

Hover/focus tooltip with placement attributes and CSS timing.

- **Tooltip** → <span>

```tsx
import {Tooltip} from 'kinu';

<Tooltip text="Info"><Button>Hover</Button></Tooltip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` | — | Tooltip text provided via the title attribute. |
| side | `"left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"` | — | The direction the tooltip should open towards. |

- Uses data attributes for fade transitions.
- Position via the placement attribute without extra JS.

### Spinner

Inline loading indicator for compact pending states.

- **Spinner** → <span>

```tsx
import {Spinner} from 'kinu';

<Spinner aria-label="Loading" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size | `SpinnerSize` | — | Size preset for the spinner. |
| type | `SpinnerType` | — | Visual style preset for the spinner. |
| variant | `SpinnerVariant` | — | Optional semantic color override. Defaults to inherited text color. |

- Wraps a <span> and animates purely in CSS.
- Supports size="sm" and size="lg" attributes for dense or prominent loading states.

### Progress

Styled progress meter with determinate and indeterminate states.

- **Progress** → <progress>

```tsx
import {Progress} from 'kinu';

<Progress value={60} max={100} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `number` | — | Current progress value. |
| max | `number` | — | Maximum progress value. |
| data-state | `"indeterminate"` | — | Marks the progress as indeterminate for styling. |

- Wraps the native `<progress>` element for semantics.
- Use the data-state attribute for indeterminate styling.

### Aspect Ratio

Maintains responsive boxes at a fixed ratio using pure CSS.

- **AspectRatio**

```tsx
import {AspectRatio} from 'kinu';

<AspectRatio ratio="16 / 9">
  <img src="..." alt="Video thumbnail" />
</AspectRatio>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ratio | `string` | — | Aspect ratio expressed as a CSS ratio string (e.g. "16 / 9"). |

- Wraps a `<div>` that defines the ratio using a CSS custom property.

### Popover

Lightweight popover using native dialog with trigger/content primitives.

- **Popover**
- **PopoverTrigger**
- **PopoverContent**
- **PopoverClose**

```tsx
import {Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger><Button>Open</Button></PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent>Content</PopoverContent>
  <PopoverClose><Button>Close</Button></PopoverClose>
</Popover>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Popover.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the popover content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |
| PopoverContent.id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

- Control placement with the placement attribute on PopoverContent.
- Stays declarative thanks to the commands polyfill.

### Scroll Area

Overflow wrapper with custom scrollbars and shadow indicators.

- **ScrollArea** → <div>

```tsx
import {ScrollArea} from 'kinu';

<ScrollArea style={{height: '200px'}}><div>Long content</div></ScrollArea>
```

- Applies scroll shadows using CSS masks.
- Forwards native overflow attributes for flexibility.

### Resizable

Resizable container that exposes native CSS handles.

- **Resizable** → <div>

```tsx
import {Resizable} from 'kinu';

<Resizable style={{width: "20rem", height: "12rem"}} />
```

- Wraps a `<div>` with resize: both so the browser handles drag gestures.
- Perfect for scratchpads, preview panes, or demos where users adjust size.

### Separator

Semantic horizontal or vertical divider.

- **Separator** → <div>

```tsx
import {Separator} from 'kinu';

<Separator />
```

- Rendered as a `<div>` so you can set orientation via attribute.
- Use decorative when the separator is purely visual.

### Sidebar

Responsive sidebar dialog that collapses on mobile.

- **SidebarTrigger** → <button>
- **Sidebar** → <dialog>

```tsx
import {Sidebar, SidebarTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Sidebar id="app-sidebar">
  <nav>...</nav>
</Sidebar>
<SidebarTrigger commandFor="app-sidebar">Toggle</SidebarTrigger>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SidebarTrigger.commandFor | `string` | — | Target sidebar ID to control. |
| Sidebar.id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the sidebar dialog. |

- Renders a `<dialog>` so it can slide in as a modal on small screens.
- SidebarTrigger toggles the hidden/open state with the command attribute.

### Tabs

TabList, Tab, and TabPanel wrappers using aria attributes.

- **TabList** → <div>
- **Tab** → <button>
- **TabPanel** → <div>

```tsx
import {Tab, TabList, TabPanel} from 'kinu';

<TabList role="tablist">
  <Tab role="tab" aria-selected="true">Account</Tab>
  <Tab role="tab" aria-selected="false">Password</Tab>
</TabList>
<TabPanel role="tabpanel">Account settings</TabPanel>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tab.aria-selected | `boolean | "true" | "false"` | — | Marks the tab as selected. |
| Tab.disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable tab interactions. |
| TabPanel.hidden | `boolean` | — | Hide the panel when inactive. |

- Control selection state by toggling aria-selected.
- TabPanel toggles the hidden attribute so CSS handles transitions.

### Breadcrumb

Composable breadcrumb trail built from list primitives.

- **Breadcrumb** → <nav>
- **BreadcrumbList** → <ol>
- **BreadcrumbItem** → <li>
- **BreadcrumbLink** → <a>

```tsx
import {Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList} from 'kinu';

<Breadcrumb>
  <BreadcrumbList>
    <BreadcrumbItem><BreadcrumbLink href="/">Home</BreadcrumbLink></BreadcrumbItem>
  </BreadcrumbList>
</Breadcrumb>
```

- Ships structural wrappers so you can supply router-aware links.
- Uses semantic list markup for accessibility.

### Navigation Menu

Composable navigation with list, item, and link helpers.

- **NavigationMenu** → <nav>
- **NavigationMenuList** → <ul>
- **NavigationMenuItem** → <li>
- **NavigationMenuLink** → <a>

```tsx
import {NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuList} from 'kinu';

<NavigationMenu>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/docs">Docs</NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
  </NavigationMenuList>
</NavigationMenu>
```

- Zero runtime state; rely on CSS for active styling.
- Ideal for top-level navigation bars.

### Menubar

Horizontal command bar composed of styled buttons.

- **Menubar** → <nav>
- **MenubarItem** → <button>

```tsx
import {Menubar, MenubarItem} from 'kinu';

<Menubar>
  <MenubarItem>File</MenubarItem>
</Menubar>
```

- Pairs nicely with dropdowns for nested menus.

### Pagination

Semantic pagination list with previous/next helpers.

- **Pagination** → <nav>
- **PaginationList** → <ul>
- **PaginationItem** → <li>
- **PaginationLink** → <button>

```tsx
import {Pagination, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationList} from 'kinu';

<Pagination>
  <PaginationList>
    <PaginationItem><PaginationLink aria-current="page">1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
  </PaginationList>
</Pagination>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PaginationLink.aria-current | `boolean | "page" | "true" | "false"` | — | Marks the current page for styling. |

- Renders `<nav>` and list markup for accessibility.
- Use aria-current on the active page link.

### Toast

Event-driven notification system. Render `<ToastContainer />` once near the app root.

```tsx
import { toast, ToastContainer } from 'kinu';

<ToastContainer />
toast.show('Saved!');
toast.show('Uploaded', { title: 'Success', icon: '✅', action: <button>Undo</button>, duration: 4000 });
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `ComponentChild` | — | Title above the toast body |
| icon | `ComponentChild` | — | Icon element |
| action | `ComponentChild` | — | Action element (e.g. undo button) |
| duration | `number` | 3000 | Auto-dismiss delay in ms |

## Theming

Override `--k-*` CSS custom properties. Values are space-separated HSL triplets.

```css
:root { --k-primary: 221 83% 53%; --k-radius: 0.625rem; }
[data-theme="dark"] { --k-background: 224 71% 4%; }
```

Toggle dark mode: `document.documentElement.dataset.theme = "dark";`

## Commands

Declarative dialog control via `command`/`commandFor` attributes (polyfilled):

```tsx
<Button command="show-modal" commandFor="my-dialog">Open</Button>
<dialog id="my-dialog">...</dialog>
```

Built-in commands: `show-modal`, `show`, `close`, `show-popover`, `hide-popover`, `toggle-popover`.
Custom commands start with `--` (e.g. `--prev`, `--next` for Carousel).

## CSS Selectors

```css
[k="button"] { }                          /* Base button */
[k="button"][variant="secondary"] { }     /* Variant */
[k="button"][size="sm"] { }               /* Size */
[k="button"][loading] { }                 /* Boolean state */
[k="button"][disabled] { }                /* Disabled */
```

---

For the full API with every prop, type alias, design token, and pattern, see llms-full.txt.
